answer: Honest participants recover their stake on exit, forming a haven of verified participants, while the slashed deposits of caught duplicates fall into a canyon of lost funds that makes forgery economically irrational. Require each agent to stake tokens at a bridge contract before joining, and to prove liveness by periodically signing epoch challenges; a sybil farm must fund and maintain every identity, so mass fake accounts bleed staking capital plus bandwidth costs each epoch. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
